messages.title: Standard Greeting
messages.text:
Hi there!

I am reaching out regarding your ticket. Could you please share more details about the issue you're facing so I can assist you better?

messages.title: Greeting - Anydesk Request
messages.text:
Hi!

I’m from the IT department, and it’s a pleasure to meet you! I’m reaching out regarding your request. To assist you, please follow these steps:

Download the AnyDesk program:
If you’re using Windows, you can download it from this link: https://anydesk.com/en or search for it in your browser.
If you’re using macOS, please download it from this link: https://anydesk.com/en/downloads/mac-os

Install the program:
On Windows: Follow the on-screen installation instructions.
On macOS: After installation, go to System Settings > Privacy & Security and grant AnyDesk access to Screen Recording and Accessibility.

Open AnyDesk and send me your AnyDesk address (a 9–11 digit code).

Important: While I am connected to your computer, please do not leave your device without notifying me first.

Please note that we are no longer able to accept IT support requests via direct messages. Kindly submit a ticket through IT Helpdesk. Thank you for your understanding!

messages.title: Follow-Up Message
messages.text:
Hello!

 I am just checking in regarding your ticket. Are you still experiencing the issue?

messages.title: Ticket Closure Notification
messages.text:
Hi there!

 I wanted to follow up on your ticket. Since I haven't heard back from you, I'll be closing the ticket for now. If you still need assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out again. Thank you!

messages.title: Asking User to get Approval
messages.text: Okay great, can you please obtain approval from your manager to proceed with the requested changes? You can send me a screenshot of the approval once you have it.

messages.title: Asking for Anydesk ID
messages.text:
Hello!

Could you please provide me with your Anydesk ID so that I can remotely access your computer to assist you further?

messages.title: Closing Message
messages.text: Thanks for your patience. Please let me know if you need anything else.

categories.name: Laptop & Virtual Machine Issues and Requests

messages.title: Checks Before Laptop Replacement
messages.text: We have received your request for a replacement laptop. Before proceeding, I will run some checks on your device to see if the issue can be fixed.

messages.title: Sign Out and Sign In
messages.text: Can you please try signing out of your account and then signing back in?

messages.title: Device Restart
messages.text: Please try restarting your device and let me know if the issue persists.

messages.title: Laptop Hard Restart Steps
messages.text:
To perform a hard restart on your laptop, please follow these steps:

1. Press and hold the power button on your laptop for about 10-15 seconds until the device powers off completely.
2. Wait for a few seconds to ensure that the laptop is fully turned off.
3. Press the power button again to turn the laptop back on.

Once your laptop has restarted, please check if the issue you were experiencing has been resolved.

messages.title: Virtual Machine Restart Complete
messages.text: I have restarted your virtual machine. Please let me know if it is functioning better now.

messages.title: Laptop Delivery Issue
messages.text: We are experiencing delays with laptop deliveries. We will keep you updated on the status of your order.

messages.title: New Laptop Setup Steps
messages.text:
Hello! I hope you are doing well.
I am reaching out to you with regards to your new laptop which requires some setup. I will be assisting you with this, please let me know when you might have some time and we can begin the process.

messages.title: Software Request Received
messages.text:
Hi there!

 We received your software request. Admin approval is required. I'll notify you once approved.

messages.title: Application Installation Complete
messages.text: The software has been successfully installed on your device.

messages.title: Installation in Progress
messages.text: I am currently installing the requested software on your device. I'll let you know once completed.

messages.title: UiPath Bot Type Clarification
messages.text: Could you please specify which type of UiPath bot you would like to install?

messages.title: Temporary Admin Rights Granted - Mosyle
messages.text: Temporary admin rights have been granted. Please proceed with the installation and let me know once it's complete.

messages.title: Compatibility Check
messages.text: Please verify that your device meets the minimum system requirements for the software.

messages.title: Time Estimate
messages.text: I estimate it might take 10-15 minutes to resolve your issue. I appreciate your patience while I work on it.

messages.title: Provide Temporary Workaround
messages.text: Would you like me to provide a temporary workaround while we work on a permanent solution?

messages.title: Escalation Confirmation
messages.text: I have escalated your issue to our senior management team. They will review it and get back to you shortly.

messages.title: Temporary Workaround Implemented
messages.text: I have implemented a temporary workaround for your issue. Please let me know if it helps or if you need further assistance.

messages.title: New Device Setup Steps
messages.text:
To get started with your new Windows laptop, please follow these initial setup steps:

1. Power On: Press the power button to turn on your laptop.
2. Initial Setup: Follow the on-screen instructions to select your region, language, and keyboard layout.
3. Connect to Wi-Fi: Choose your Wi-Fi network and enter the password to connect.
4. Sign In: Use your company credentials to sign in. If you don't have them yet, please contact IT support.
5. Install Updates: Once signed in, please install Anydesk on your device using this link: [https://anydesk.com/en].
6.Then please share your AnyDesk ID with us so we can assist you further.

If you encounter any issues during the setup process, feel free to reach out for assistance.

messages.title: Ticket Logging Request
messages.text: For better tracking and assistance, could you please log a ticket using this link? https://helpdesk.infuse.com. This will help us manage and resolve your issue more efficiently. Thank you!

messages.title: IT Policy Update Notification
messages.text: Please be informed that there has been an update to our IT policies. Kindly review the changes at your earliest convenience.

messages.title: Ticket Takeover Notification
messages.text: Hello! I have taken over your ticket and will be assisting you from now on. Please let me know if you have any questions or need further assistance.

messages.title: Ticket Reassignment Notification
messages.text: I have reassigned your ticket to another agent who will be able to assist you further. Please expect a follow-up message shortly.

messages.title: Ticket Escalation Notification
messages.text: Your ticket has been escalated to a higher-level support team. Please expect a follow-up message shortly.

messages.title: VPN Connection Issue
messages.text: I understand you're experiencing issues with your VPN connection. Could you please provide more details about the problem you're facing?.

messages.title: Request for Screenshot
messages.text: Could you please provide a screenshot of the error message or issue you're encountering?

messages.title: Login Issue Steps
messages.text:
Please try the following steps:

1. On the login screen, click on 'Other User' on the bottom left of the screen.
2. Enter your username and password.
3. If you continue to experience issues, please let me know so we can explore further solutions.

messages.title: Change Department Information
messages.text: Hello! I am aware you are changing departments soon. I will assist you with updating your information and access accordingly.
